q: The stable manifold theorem for a hyperbolic fixed point guarantees the existence of W^s(x*) as an injectively immersed submanifold of the same dimension as the stable subspace. Near x*, W^s is:
opts: Tangent to E^s at x* and an exact graph over E^s (via the Perron-Irwin method)
exp: The stable manifold is tangent to E^s (the stable eigenspace) at x*, and locally is a graph over E^s. It is as smooth as the vector field (C^r if f ∈ C^r). The Hadamard-Perron proof constructs it as a fixed point of a graph-transform operator.
